runtime.optimizer_scope: Unchanged foreach AdamW; only the compiled-model case wraps model forward/backward.
runtime.refinement_policy: Independent gate for every combination; prior native-fused failure and numerical tolerances unchanged.

optimization_metadata.gradient_metadata_guard: Every case checks all five dense float32 MPS gradients and parameter-matching shapes after backward; no gradient values are read to CPU.
optimization_metadata.gradient_clip_implementation: native Metal blockwise norm and in-place scaling
optimization_metadata.metal_step_stats_policy: new two-float buffer per update; norm/scale history must not alias later steps
optimization_metadata.unsupported_policy: Propagate the original exception; no eager/CPU/foreach fallback.
optimization_metadata.setup_timing_scope: Host-observed setup only; first-forward compilation and warmup execution remain outside training timing.
optimization_metadata.refinement: Compose accepted Metal clipping, None gradients and model-only compilation; unchanged foreach AdamW.

metal_clip.implementation: three native Metal kernels; float32 block sum of squares
metal_clip.shape_binding: host tensor metadata; Python integer tuple binds constant int64 ends
metal_clip.partial_write_contract: lane 0 of every full group overwrites its partial, including an empty logical block
metal_clip.returned_scalars: separate 0-D views of that call's fresh result buffer

reset.weights: copied from unchanged C-initialized tensor in place
reset.adam_moments_and_step: existing state tensors zeroed in place on their actual device
reset.gradient_clear_policy: existing gradient tensors zeroed in place

memory_snapshot_after_audit.scope: End snapshot, not peak; unified memory must not be added to RSS.

measurement.initialization: xorshift32 uniform[-0.01,0.01); zero seed maps to 0x9e3779b9
measurement.final_loss_phase: after timed updates on last mini-batch; evaluation excluded from timer
measurement.scope: Short real Wiki RAM-resident CPU timing; includes window gather and updates; no complete epoch or quality comparison

corpus.load_scope: file_read_RAM_load including validation; OS file-cache state uncontrolled, not cold SSD I/O
corpus.sampling_policy: deterministic C affine permutation, coprime multiplier, unique targets per pass; differs from legacy hash sampler

measurement.phase_scope: non-overlapping caller wall time; includes scheduling waits and timer overhead; excludes warmup and final evaluation

measurement.cpu_scope: boundary snapshots around timed update loop; process/rusage include all process workers, thread is calling thread only; setup/warmup/final evaluation and checksum scans excluded
measurement.per_update_scope: wall intervals and non-overlapping phase deltas; overall wall also includes record bookkeeping; no per-update JSON or allocation inside timed loop

policy.changed_condition: Hidden width 128 vs 64; not the same model or initialization arrays. Same V35328/C8/D64/B512/FP32/dense AdamW/clip1/real Wiki target stream.
policy.quality: No convergence or 2/3/5 epoch loss measured. H64 may underfit or yield worse held-out loss; smaller architecture must be evaluated.
policy.numeric_scope: Unchanged generic C engine, existing tiny/irregular independent checks, B512 full-V softmax unit coverage and full-state finiteness. No new independent full-model H64/B512 gate.
policy.timing_scope: Short real data throughput only; full epoch times extrapolated. Setup/evaluation/checkpoint/long thermal excluded.

budget.confirmation_policy: Preserved v1 short pilot; common work doubled to 256 updates / 131072 targets for both architectures; no candidate-specific retuning.

4.decision: Improvement observed at six threads, but strong control variability prevents a universal fixed speedup claim. Four-thread signs are mixed; retain as experimental candidate.

6.decision: Improvement observed at six threads, but strong control variability prevents a universal fixed speedup claim. Four-thread signs are mixed; retain as experimental candidate.

earlier_cpu_reference.scope: Earlier cohort, not the denominator for a new improvement claim.

decision.fixed_B128: Six-thread ILP is bit-identical over the tested 512 updates, with three shorter softmax/wall observations; keep experimental because background load is highly variable.
decision.larger_batch: B512 is the fastest throughput observation in this CPU cohort. It changes Adam update count and learning statistics; quality is unmeasured.
decision.budget: Lower-load confirmation at B512: H128 full two epochs extrapolate to about 7.42h; H64 about 6.02h. H128 under previous heavier load extrapolated to 10.57h. These are candidates, not an eight-hour guarantee. H64 changes model capacity and B512 changes update count; evaluate held-out loss in actual training.
decision.long_training: Deferred. This bounded C executable supports at most 4096 updates and does not provide the actual epoch/checkpoint/evaluation trainer. No actual 2/3/5 epoch loss, PPL or generation comparison exists.
decision.word2vec: Cancelled by latest user direction; NPLM only. No Word2Vec model was trained.
decision.unmeasured_devices: Intel i5-8250U and NVIDIA not measured. Access deferred; no cloud rented.

review_responses: Claude Opus5.5 Ultrathink reviewed advice, implementation, and final code. Root retained failures and unchanged tolerances.
Strong load/control variability is recorded. Four-thread ILP is inconclusive. Six-thread shorter observations and softmax phase reductions are observations, not proof of a fixed general speedup.
GPU and CPU include their real input preparation. GPU preload/transfer is included, CPU gathers per update. Matched initial/input/sampler work, not identical input scheduling.
Small array storage does not establish that system RAM is unconstrained; other apps and unified memory compete. Only measured process RSS is reported.
Benchmark throughput and a short training loss cannot prove convergence or generation quality. Changing epochs does not imply a known quality penalty.
